name: What does finish carpentry include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry focuses on the visible, aesthetic elements of a construction project. This includes installing trim work like baseboards, crown molding, door and window casings, and chair rails. It also covers the installation of custom built-ins, wainscoting, mantels, and cabinetry. The goal is to enhance the interior's visual appeal and provide a polished look, often involving precise measurements and careful detailing to achieve a high-quality finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry involves installing visible, aesthetic elements like trim, molding, built-ins, and cabinetry to complete the interior look of a space.
